examples.english: As the day advanced, bullying increased. It began with comments like "what a gross person is the pedophile" or "typical deranged person with the profile photo of a loli covered with cum." Afterwards, they began to push him between classes. During the break, they surrounded him and pelted him with insults. They spat on him. On his way to the exit, the worst seemed about the happen. More than 50 students followed him on his way home. The teacher caught up with him in his car before them, and made him get on with him.
examples.ref: 2022, Jonathan Treviño, “Ouija”, in Demencia y aberraciones: Antología de terror, Editorial Mástil:
examples.text: A lo largo del día, el acoso fue aumentando. Comenzó con comentarios como «que asco con el fan de cuties» o «típico enfermo con foto de perfil de loli cumeada». Luego, comenzaron a empujarlo entre clases. En el descanso, lo rodearon y lo llenaron de insultos. Le escupieron. Hacia la salida, parecía que lo peor sucedería. Más de 50 alumnos lo siguieron en su camino a casa. El maestro lo alcanzó en su coche antes que ellos, y lo hizo subir a él.
examples.translation: As the day advanced, bullying increased. It began with comments like "what a gross person is the pedophile" or "typical deranged person with the profile photo of a loli covered with cum." Afterwards, they began to push him between classes. During the break, they surrounded him and pelted him with insults. They spat on him. On his way to the exit, the worst seemed about the happen. More than 50 students followed him on his way home. The teacher caught up with him in his car before them, and made him get on with him.
